title: Enhanced integral derived coefficients
statement: Use the unbounded cochain and quasi-isomorphism conventions of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], coherent localization universal on full coherent functor categories as in [lem-coef-finite-reedy-localization], and the monoidal infinity-category presentation of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. An integral derived coefficient presentation consists of a monoidal infinity category, a coherent localization of the nerve of all unbounded cochain complexes of small integer modules at quasi-isomorphisms, and its derived tensor and unit. For universe compatibility the integer ring is canonically lifted to the module universe. A binary tensor is specified as active monoidal transport; on pairs of K-flat representatives it is naturally equivalent to localization of their direct-sum total tensor with Koszul signs. Its unit is localization of the ordinary tensor unit, the integer complex in degree zero. Localization means equivalence on entire quasi-isomorphism-inverting coherent functor categories, not localization of an ordinary homotopy category.
